in_marathi.name: Arulmozhi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arulmozhi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Arulmozhi means 'Graceful Goddess'. This name is derived from the Tamil language and is often used in Hinduism. Arulmozhi is a powerful name that symbolizes protection, luxury, and prosperity. It is believed that those named Arulmozhi are blessed with the grace of the gods and are able to overcome any obstacle with ease.
